# layout-width

<!-- okfreq:index:start -->
<!-- Generated by okfreq lint; edit requirement metadata instead. -->

- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-001 — The preview page never scrolls sideways](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-001.md) — When a document holds wide content, long words or long URLs, the extension SHALL keep the preview page free of sideways scrolling in every width mode, theme and pane width.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-002 — The text column is capped and centred](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-002.md) — When the preview is shown at 100 percent zoom in a pane wider than the configured maximum content width, the extension SHALL show a text column exactly that wide, centred in the pane.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-003 — The maximum content width is rounded and capped at 2400](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-003.md) — When the setting markdownOkfSchemaStudio.preview.maxContentWidth is read, the extension SHALL round it to a whole number of pixels and cut it to at most 2400.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-004 — A width of zero lifts the column limit](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-004.md) — When the setting maxContentWidth is 0, the extension SHALL write the width rule as none so that the text column has no cap and follows the pane width.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-005 — Each rendered page carries the width rule](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-005.md) — When the extension builds the HTML of a preview page, it SHALL include the width rule of the configured maximum content width in the page style.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-006 — Open previews follow a change of the width setting](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-006.md) — When the setting maxContentWidth changes, the extension SHALL read it again and update every open preview from its last good render without reloading the editor.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-007 — The first element starts 40 px below the top in read mode](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-007.md) — When a document opens in read mode, the extension SHALL start its first element 40 px below the top of the pane as a top margin of that element, whatever the element is.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-008 — The first element starts 40 px below the top in edit mode](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-008.md) — When a document opens in edit mode, the extension SHALL start its first element 40 px below the top of the pane, as it does in read mode.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-009 — The open first-block editor keeps the 40 px gap](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-009.md) — When the first block of a document is open in its block editor, the extension SHALL start the editor frame, with its edition palette on top, 40 px below the top of the pane.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-010 — The Start writing button starts 40 px below the top](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-010.md) — When an empty document is shown in edit mode, the extension SHALL start the Start writing button 40 px below the top of the pane.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-011 — No clearance is added where the toolbar does not cover the first element](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-011.md) — When the floating toolbar sits beside the text column or ends above the 40 px gap, the extension SHALL publish a clearance of 0 and an inset of 0 so that the first element keeps exactly 40 px.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-012 — A first-block editor too narrow to be narrowed is pushed below the toolbar](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-012.md) — When the floating toolbar covers an open first-block editor and giving up the toolbar width would leave the frame under 320 px, the extension SHALL push the frame down just far enough to clear the toolbar.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-013 — Collapsing the toolbar measures the clearance again](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-013.md) — When the toolbar is collapsed or expanded, the extension SHALL measure the first-element clearance again.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-014 — A first-block editor gives up the width the toolbar covers](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-014.md) — When the floating toolbar overlaps an open first-block editor and at least 320 px would remain, the extension SHALL shorten the frame by the width the toolbar covers through an inline-end inset, keeping the 40 px gap.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-015 — The Start writing button is pushed only when it sits under the toolbar](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-015.md) — When the Start writing button itself shares horizontal space with the floating toolbar and the toolbar reaches below the 40 px gap, the extension SHALL push the button down just far enough to clear the toolbar.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-016 — A leading properties table gives up the toolbar width for its Description toggle](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-016.md) — When a right-aligned Description toggle of a leading properties table sits under the floating toolbar, the extension SHALL shorten the table by the width the toolbar covers.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-017 — The toolbar bottom edge is published for the sticky palette](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-017.md) — When the floating toolbar shares horizontal space with the text column, the extension SHALL publish its bottom edge plus 8 px as --sphinx- preview-toolbar-bottom, and 0 otherwise.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-018 — The first-element clearance is measured again after layout events](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-018.md) — When the window is resized, the column, toolbar or leading properties table changes size, the toolbar or column content mutates, a root attribute changes, a web font loads or the window loads, the extension SHALL measure the first-element clearance again.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-019 — Bursts of clearance updates are limited](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-019.md) — When more than 200 clearance updates occur within one second, the extension SHALL limit them by skipping the excess and measuring the last change in one trailing update.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-020 — The Width button cycles Margin, Auto and Full width](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-020.md) — When the reader presses the Width button, the extension SHALL switch the width mode in the order Margin, Auto, Full width and back to Margin and update its icon, label and tooltip.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-021 — A width mode choice is saved for the workspace](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-021.md) — When the reader changes the width mode, the extension SHALL keep the choice in the webview state and send it to the host as a workspace preference.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-022 — Margin width mode keeps blocks inside the text column](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-022.md) — When the width mode is Margin, the extension SHALL keep tables, code blocks and figures inside the text column and let them scroll or wrap instead of leaving it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-023 — Auto width lets wide blocks break out of the column](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-023.md) — When the width mode is Auto, the extension SHALL widen a table, figure, image, code block or Mermaid diagram that is wider than the text column to the width it needs, up to the available area, centred on that area.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-024 — Auto width excludes the open table-of-contents column](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-024.md) — When the table-of-contents column is open in Auto width mode, the extension SHALL exclude its 256 px from the available area, from the centre of the breakout and from the cap.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-025 — Auto measures a wide table uncapped and rounds up](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-025.md) — When the width mode is Auto, the extension SHALL measure a wide table without the column cap and round its width up to the next pixel so that no cell wraps in the broken-out table.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-026 — Auto leaves edited and relatively sized elements in the column](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-026.md) — When an element is under edit, or a figure has a size given in %, em or rem, the extension SHALL keep it at the column width in Auto width mode.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-027 — Auto uses the author's pixel width for an image breakout](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-027.md) — When an image carries a pixel width written by its author, the extension SHALL compute its breakout in Auto width mode from that width instead of the intrinsic size, ignoring a gain of 1 px or less.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-028 — Full width removes the column limit](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-028.md) — When the width mode is Full width, the extension SHALL lift the column limit and set the page side gutter to 16 px.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-029 — Narrow tables and figures are centred in every width mode](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-029.md) — When a table or figure is narrower than the text column, the extension SHALL centre it at its own width in every width mode and keep code blocks left.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-030 — A paragraph holding only an image is marked as a figure](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-030.md) — When a top-level paragraph holds only one image and no text, the extension SHALL mark it with data-sphinx-preview-figure in every width mode.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-031 — Auto measures wide elements again when the layout changes](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-031.md) — When the layout may have changed, the extension SHALL measure the wide elements again in Auto width mode, after a content patch, a resize, an image load, a toolbar collapse, a table-of-contents toggle or a change of the edited element.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-032 — A wide table scrolls inside its own box](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-032.md) — When a table is wider than the pane outside Auto breakout, the extension SHALL let it scroll sideways inside its own box, limited to the column width, without widening the page.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-033 — A scrolling table shades its overflowing edges](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-033.md) — When a table is more than 1 px wider than its box, the extension SHALL mark it as overflowing so that the theme shades its edges, and remove the mark when the table fits.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-034 — Short identifiers stay on one line in a scrolling table](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-034.md) — When a table overflows, the extension SHALL keep a cell holding a single word of at most 24 characters on one line.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-035 — Machine geometry checks report four layout defects](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-035.md) — When a maintainer runs the geometry checks on a rendered preview, the extension SHALL report overlay-covers-text, overlay-clipped, identifier-split and status-two-lines, each passing when no matching content exists.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-036 — A negative or non-numeric width falls back to 960](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-036.md) — When the setting maxContentWidth is negative or not a finite number, the extension SHALL use the default width of 960 pixels.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-037 — A leading properties table is pushed down for a control under the toolbar](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-037.md) — When a left-aligned badge or link of a leading properties table sits under the floating toolbar, the extension SHALL push the table down just far enough to clear the toolbar.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-038 — The saved width mode is restored when the page starts](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-038.md) — When the preview page starts, the extension SHALL apply the saved webview state first, then the stored workspace preference, then Margin.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-039 — Full width centres the content with gutters of at least 15 px](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-039.md) — When the width mode is Full width, the extension SHALL centre text, tables, code blocks and figures on the pane with gutters of at least 15 px.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-040 — A width mode change keeps the reading line](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-040.md) — When the reader changes the width mode, the extension SHALL keep the line at the reading position of the page.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-041 — A width mode change measures the first-element clearance again](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LAYOUT-041.md) — When the reader changes the width mode, the extension SHALL measure the first-element clearance again.
